items.quote:

items.what: Base class must call an overridable hook named `_get_embeddings(texts) -> torch.Tensor` that subclasses implement
items.quote:
def _get_embeddings(self, texts: list[str]) -> torch.Tensor:
    return torch.tensor([self.embeddings[text] for text in texts], ...)

reason: The instruction covers the algorithms, payloads, and error contracts, but never names the package file paths or the subclass-overridable embedding hook `_get_embeddings`, both of which the tests require exactly.
